notes: Waves are derivable from deps (wave = 1 + max(dep waves)). Files within a wave are disjoint. T5 replaces the llm.py stub T2 creates (sequential, deps enforce order). All verify steps are headless: pytest / TestClient / npm build+vitest. Browser checks are orchestrator-gate only.

WRITE GOLDEN FIXTURES FIRST with hand-computed expected values (comp_score to 4 decimal places; fixture_draft_flow has one full legal 18-action draft and 4 illegal-action cases: wrong turn, re-pick, banned-then-picked, post-complete action), then code until pytest passes. Zero network, zero DB.
